pr_title: samples: flash_shell: Fix overwriting return value
pr_body:
Value of ret has been overwritten by flash_write_protection_set
before it could be returned from do_write_unaligned, which could
lead to reporting success when error code should have been returned.

Fixes zephyrproject-rtos#27641, Coverity-CID: 212142
Fixes zephyrproject-rtos#27642, Coverity-CID: 212143

Signed-off-by: Dominik Ermel <dominik.ermel@nordicsemi.no>

issue_context.title: [Coverity CID :212142] Unused value in samples/drivers/flash_shell/src/main.c

review_comments: it seems that the error is meaningless, I mean, the check is just for something != 0. So you could re-use the variable `ret` and return a negative value later, another thing is that we don't declare variables ad-hoc. Though the fix is correct and avoid possible return 0 in case of error.
